identity.title: Radio and Millimeter Monitoring of Sgr A*: Spectrum, Variability, and Constraints on the G2 Encounter

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report new observations with the Very Large Array, Atacama Large Millimeter Array, and Submillimeter Array at frequencies from 1.0 to 355 GHz of the Galactic Center black hole, Sagittarius A\*.

question.value: Did the G2 encounter change the radio-to-millimeter flux density or spectrum of Sgr A*, and what is the millimeter spectral index?

evidence.quote: we find no evidence for a change in the mean flux density or spectrum of Sgr A\* that can be attributed to interaction with the G2 source.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA# 2012.1.00635.S.

evidence.quote: Observations were snapshots with durations of a few minutes.
